title: Routing mix
label: A day's routing read as a distribution. In the top right corner a small pegboard drops 200 payments one at a time; each bounces left or right off four rows of pegs and leaves through one of five exits onto its own track, which carries it across the page into a wide bin. The payments stack in the bins as dots and build a histogram over the full width. Under each bin the share is counted from the payments that landed: Processor A 4%, Processor B 6%, Processor C 10%, Processor D 38% and Processor E 42%. A dashed line marks the 30% target for each top processor; D and E rise above it. At the top, the share sent to processors that approve 95% or more settles at 80% of 200 payments, under the rule EU cards to highest approval.
heading:
Where every payment
ended up.
sub: Shares are counted from the payments that landed. Nothing is modelled.
